messages:
Jules (Docs): Quick check-in: I opened PR to combine 429, timeout, and context-trim guidance and add SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301. Need one eng and one SDK review.

Marco (Eng): Quick note: runtime fallback order is model-variant -> family-compact -> cross-region (only if routing allows). Dedicated can opt out. Add that line.

Ivy (SDK): Will add JS/Python retry helpers. Confirming SDK honors Retry-After and uses exponential backoff (base 200ms) when absent.

Jules (Docs): Thanks. Can you include a tiny trim helper that keeps last N messages to respect token caps? Ops asks for explicit example.

Ivy (SDK): Added a short pseudo function `trimConversation(history, maxTokens=2048)` in the snippet. Also adding a curl example that shows `Retry-After: 5`.

Marco (Eng): Also call out recommended client-wide timeout (e.g., 30s) and per-try timeout to avoid runaway retries.

OpsBot: Heads-up: replaced deprecated link `/docs/retries` with `/docs/troubleshooting/fallbacks`.

Jules (Docs): Great. I'll update the PR with the callouts and merge after 36h if no blockers. Tagging @Ivy and @Marco for final checks. :shipit:
